Metadata.Title: RHSA-2026:102710: kernel security, bug fix, and enhancement update (Important)

Platforms: Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.8 Extended Update Support

Metadata.Description:
The kernel packages contain the Linux kernel, the core of any Linux operating system.

Security Fix(es):

* kernel: Kernel: Denial of Service in network socket error handling (CVE-2026-22977)

* kernel: mm/damon/ops-common: handle extreme intervals in damon_hot_score() (CVE-2026-64458)

* kernel: crypto: ecc - Fix carry overflow in vli multiplication (CVE-2026-64313)

* kernel: proc: protect ptrace_may_access() with exec_update_lock (FD links) (CVE-2026-64375)

* kernel: ALSA: usx2y: us144mkii: fix work UAF on disconnect (CVE-2026-64491)

* kernel: Bluetooth: bpa10x: avoid OOB read of revision string in bpa10x_setup() (CVE-2026-64549)

* kernel: fscrypt: Add missing superblock check in find_or_insert_direct_key() (CVE-2026-68148)

* kernel: wifi: mac80211: validate extension-frame layout before RX (CVE-2026-68470)

* kernel: scsi: target: Bound PR-OUT TransportID parsing to the received buffer (CVE-2026-72084)

* kernel: drm/amdkfd: hold event_mutex while checkpointing CRIU events (CVE-2026-74446)

* kernel: dmaengine: idxd: fix fdev setup failure cleanup in idxd_cdev_open() (CVE-2026-74574)

* kernel: perf/core: Fix group leader use-after-free after sibling detach (CVE-2026-74637)

* kernel: tools/power/x86/intel-speed-select: Harden daemon pidfile open (CVE-2026-80663)

* kernel: iommu/tegra241-cmdqv: Reject a vSID wider than the SID_MATCH field (CVE-2026-89450)

* kernel: nvdimm/btt: reject an arena whose nfree is below the lane count (CVE-2026-89965)

* kernel: PCI/sysfs: Add lockdown checks to legacy I/O and memory handlers (CVE-2026-90315)

* kernel: slip: remove slip_hangup() to fix use-after-free in slip_receive_buf() (CVE-2026-90057)

* kernel: drm/amdkfd: fix SMI event cross-process information leak (CVE-2026-97422)

* kernel: drm/amd/pm: bound pp_dpm_set_pp_table() memcpy (CVE-2026-97427)

* kernel: drm/amdkfd: Check bounds for allocate_sdma_queue restore_sdma_id (CVE-2026-97497)

* kernel: drm/amdgpu: validate and share PSP fw_pri_buf copies via psp_copy_fw (CVE-2026-97494)

* kernel: drm/amdkfd: Check bounds on allocate_doorbell (CVE-2026-97495)

* kernel: drm/amdgpu: Bound GPIO I2C table entry count from VBIOS (CVE-2026-97493)

* kernel: drm/amdgpu: fix buffer overflow during vBIOS update (CVE-2026-97425)

* kernel: drm/amdkfd: Fix OOB memory exposure in get_wave_state() (CVE-2026-97496)

* kernel: scsi: qla2xxx: Unlink NVMe unsol ctx before freeing on LS reject error (CVE-2026-97528)

* kernel: kernel: arbitrary code execution via out-of-bounds stack access in scsi_cdl_enable() (CVE-2026-98232)

* kernel: RDMA/siw: Bound fragmented header copies by the remaining length (CVE-2026-98323)

* kernel: futex: Also allocate private hash on vfork() (CVE-2026-98281)

* kernel: net/sched: act_ct: fix helper UAF due to extensions realloc (CVE-2026-98442)

* kernel: cipso: adjust cached option offsets when removing CIPSO (CVE-2026-99064)

* kernel: kernel: Privilege escalation via reference counter wrap in io_uring (CVE-2026-99227)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* Backport the printk SMP startup fix [rhel-9.8.z] (JIRA:RHEL-290041)

* Backport CVEs from v7.2 [rhel-9.8.z] (JIRA:RHEL-291915)

* [IBM 9.10 FEAT] Switch SIGP to always use external call instead of emergency signal [rhel-9.8.z] (JIRA:RHEL-303480)

* RHEL 9.8 on AMD Genoa and Venice platforms require commit 38e5f33ee359 and c2e8dc1222c2  to prevent kdump hang (JIRA:RHEL-282992)

* The Kernel panic occurred at strlen+0x0 because a race event filter treats the user space pointer as a normal pointer [rhel-9.8.z] (JIRA:RHEL-291141)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
